// diagnostic

E1016

`#Inline(Always) fn` is `#Scrub`, and a `#Scrub` routine stays a call

What

`#Inline(Always) fn` is `#Scrub`, and a `#Scrub` routine stays a call

Why

`#Inline(Always)` guarantees every direct call is inlined on every tier, and a `#Scrub` routine reveals a fixed value as a public result: only its own call keeps the value fixed up to that result. Sema refuses each mark that can't keep the guarantee: a call of itself or a cycle of marked calls (E0917), a use as a value (E0918), a body over the size ceiling (E0919), `#Scrub` (E1016), a read of `context.trace` (E1017) and a foreign body (E1021)

Fix

Drop `#Inline(Always)` from the `#Scrub` routine.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1016: Tests/UI/inline_always_scrub.stderr.

Error [jet.InlineAlwaysScrub]: `redact` is `#Scrub`, so `#Inline(Always)` cannot expand it
  --> Tests/UI/inline_always_scrub.jet:4:3
    |
  4 | #[Inline(Always), Scrub(PII)]
    |   ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: A `#Scrub` routine reveals a fixed value as a public result, and only its own call keeps that value fixed up to the result; an inlined copy would let the fixed value flow on into the caller's code. `#Inline(Always)` guarantees that every direct call is inlined on every tier, or the program is refused: sema refuses a function that calls itself or closes a cycle of marked calls (E0917), one used as a value (E0918), one over the size ceiling (E0919), a `#Scrub` routine (E1016), one that reads `context.trace` (E1017) and one with a foreign body (E1021).
 Fix: Drop `#Inline(Always)`; a `#Scrub` routine stays a call.
